types.name: Config
docs: Program-wide settings. One per program, at PDA ["config"]. Lives on L1 and is never delegated,
so rollup instructions read a cloned, read-only copy.
Layout history: v1 (M1 first deploy) had no `reserved` tail. v2 appends it. `migrate_config`
upgrades a v1 account in place.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin handover: set by `propose_admin`, cleared by `accept_admin`.

fields.name: dev_wallet
docs: Receives rake.

fields.name: max_buy_in
docs: Largest buy-in any table may accept, in the table token's base units. This is the per-table
stake cap from the M0 custody decision.

fields.name: paused
docs: When true, no new tables or buy-ins. Existing players can still leave.

fields.name: escape_idle_secs
docs: How long a table's last L1 commit must be idle before an emergency undelegation request.
Carved from the old reserved bytes, so existing v2 accounts read 0 = default.

fields.name: escape_idle_secs
docs: 0 = default (1 hour).

types.name: Deck
docs: The current hand's shuffle inputs and deck. Rollup-only and readable by nobody. Seeds are for the
next hand while the table is idle; `end_hand` copies everything public into the `HandRecord`.

fields.name: seed_mask
docs: Bit i set = seat i committed a seed.

fields.name: seed_owners
docs: Who committed each seed. A seed counts only while its committer still holds the seat.

fields.name: entropy
docs: Public stand-in for the VRF output (see deal.rs).

types.name: Hand
docs: One seat's hole cards. Rollup-only and readable only by the seat's current owner. Created when a
player sits and closed when they leave.

types.name: HandRecord
docs: The last finished hand, readable by anyone so anyone can recompute its deck (tests/verifier.ts).
Rollup-only for now, overwritten each hand; M6 publishes each record to Solana.

types.name: Invites
docs: Invite list for an invite-only table. Lives on L1 (not delegated); the rollup reads a copy.
Stores sha256(table || wallet), not wallets, so the public account doesn't say who's invited.

types.name: Ledger
docs: The private part of a table: seats, stacks and money. Rollup-only (never committed, never on
L1); readable only by the players seated at the table.

fields.name: escrow_owed
docs: What the table owes: sum of stacks + unpaid rake.

fields.name: escrow_balance
docs: Escrow token balance seen right after the last money move.

fields.name: salt
docs: Secret salt, refreshed from the VRF every hand, so the public fingerprint can't be guessed
from likely wallets and amounts. All zeros until the first hand is dealt.

types.name: Seat
docs: One seat. An empty seat has `player == Pubkey::default()`.

fields.name: reader
docs: Key that may read the ledger and this seat's hand in the TEE. It is a separate key chosen by
the player's client, so permission lists (which MagicBlock's RPC shows to anyone) never name
the wallet.

fields.name: stack
docs: Chips the player has at the table, in the table token's base units.

fields.name: deposited
docs: Everything this player has put in at this seat (before rake), for the audit trail.

types.name: Table
docs: The public part of a table. Delegated to the TEE rollup and committed to L1, so everything here
becomes public on L1. Who sits where, stacks and money totals live in the private `Ledger`;
only its fingerprint is here. Fixed layout, no `Option` (M1 lesson).

fields.name: seat_mask
docs: Bit i set = seat i taken. Lets a new player pick a free seat without reading the ledger.

fields.name: rake_bps
docs: Copied from config at creation, so later rake changes don't affect open tables.

fields.name: last_activity_ts
docs: Rollup clock at the last money move; used by the escape-hatch rule.

fields.name: ledger_hash
docs: sha256 of the ledger after the last money move, and how many moves there have been.
Players' clients keep their own seat record and can check it against this.

fields.name: hand_no
docs: Hands started at this table (the current one, if one is running).

fields.name: hand_state
docs: HAND_IDLE, HAND_SHUFFLING or HAND_DEALT.

fields.name: button
docs: Dealer button of the current or last hand (meaningless while `hand_no == 0`).

fields.name: dealt_mask
docs: Seats dealt into the current hand.

fields.name: vrf_requested_ts
docs: Rollup clock when randomness was last requested.

fields.name: vrf_nonce
docs: Bumped on every randomness request (and abort). The callback must echo the current value,
so only the latest request can deal.
